title: Clock
text: Display and provide simulation time, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Display time} displays simulation time on block icon and {Decimation} sets the interval at which to update block icon. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Display time
params.values: Display simulation time on block icon off (default) | on

params.name: Decimation
params.values: Interval at which to update block icon 10 (default) | positive integer
